pending.label: EXPAT
pending.description:
Respected Hiring Managers,

I am applying for the position of Planning Engineer. I am a Civil Engineer with experience in project planning, scheduling, and progress control on construction projects within EPC environments.

I have hands-on experience in developing and maintaining baseline and updated schedules using Primavera P6 and MS Project, ensuring alignment with contractual milestones and execution plans. I coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, consultants, and subcontractors to consolidate inputs and maintain an integrated project schedule.

My role includes linking engineering, procurement, and construction activities, tracking material procurement and delivery schedules, and aligning construction sequencing with approved shop drawings. I regularly update schedules, monitor progress, identify critical path impacts and delays, and support the team with corrective and recovery planning measures.
